title: Hyundai Heavy Industries Campus Addition
summary: A circular-economies studio project: a campus addition for Hyundai Heavy Industries in Ulsan that treats material flows, reuse, and landscape systems as one design problem at industrial scale. [CONFIRM project description]

sections.heading: Brief
sections.body: [CONFIRM] Campus-scale systems thinking in an international industrial context — a different design problem from the civic floodplain work.
